title.narrative: Integrated lifesaving and life-sustaining multi-sectoral support to increase resilience of vulnerable communities in Mashnaf, As-Sweida governorate

description.narrative: ltpgtltspangtThe proposed project aims to address the pressing needs of the Mashnaf subdistrict in As-Sweida governorate, Syria, by implementing a multi-sectoral approach that focuses on rehabilitation and capacity building. The context of high inflation, increased prices of basic goods, and the aftermath of conflict have severely impacted the community’s ability to meet their basic needs. This proposal outlines a comprehensive strategy to enhance access to essential services while promoting sustainable livelihoods.lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtltspangtltbrgtlt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtThe ongoing crisis in Syria has led to significant challenges for communities in Mashnaf, including high inflation and increased prices of basic goods. The economic situation has resulted in soaring prices for food and agricultural inputs. Many families struggle to afford basic necessities, leading to food insecurity. With limited job opportunities and declining agricultural productivity, household incomes are insufficient to cover basic needs. Many families rely on subsistence farming but lack the necessary resources and training. Furthermore, years of conflict have left critical infrastructure, such as water wells and sewage networks, in disrepair. This not only affects access to clean drinking water but also poses health risks due to inadequate sanitation. Women and children are particularly affected by these challenges. Women often bear the brunt of household responsibilities and are disproportionately impacted by economic hardships.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtThus, based on the identified needs in Mashnaf subdistrict, ZOA proposes the following activities:lt/pgtltpgt ltbrgt1. WASH:lt/pgtltpgt ltbrgt - Rehabilitation of Water Well for drinking water: The project will focus on restoring a key water well in Mashnaf to ensure reliable access to safe drinking water for the community.lt/pgtltpgt- Rehabilitation of damaged sewage networks: This intervention will directly address health concerns related to waterborne diseases caused and exacerbated by poor sanitation conditions.ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtltbrgt2. Food Security and Agriculture:lt/pgtltpgt ltbrgt - Provision of agricultural/livestock inputs and training: To support local farmers facing high input costs, we will provide essential agricultural and/or livestock supplies. This support is vital for ensuring food security through animal husbandry as an alternative income source. The training sessions will equip farmers with modern techniques that enhance productivity while promoting sustainable practices.ltbrgt - Vocational training for women: Participants of FGD mentioned that women residing in the area are in need of vocational trainings on topics such as dairy production. However, ZOA will carry out FGD to enable the meaningful participation of females in selecting most beneficial topics for them. The main objective of the vocational training is to empower women by equipping them with skills that can lead to income-generating activities. By fostering women’s economic participation, we aim to improve family resilience against economic shocks.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgt3. Winterization /NFIs:lt/pgtltpgt ltbrgtProvision of heaters and olive pomace fuel: In response to energy shortages during winter months, ZOA will distribute heaters along with olive pomace fuel as an affordable heating solution. This initiative addresses immediate energy needs while promoting sustainable fuel sources derived from local resources and markets.ltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtThis multi-sectoral project is designed with an informed understanding of the unique challenges faced by the Mashnaf community in As-Sweida governorate. By addressing critical areas such as water supply, sanitation, agriculture, women’s empowerment, and energy needs, we aim not only to alleviate immediate hardships but also lay the groundwork for long-term resilience against future crises. Our approach emphasizes community involvement at every stage ensuring that interventions are relevant, culturally appropriate, and sustainable within the local context.ltbrgtlt/pgt
